## 🇩🇪 German — Daily Phrases (3)
1. **Das lässt mich nicht los.** — [das lesst mish nisht lohs] — *That won't leave me alone. / I can't stop thinking about it.*
2. **Mir fällt ein Stein vom Herzen.** — [meer felt ain shtain fom HAIR-tsen] — *That's a weight off my shoulders.*
3. **Ich bin in meinem Element.** — [ish bin in MY-nem eh-leh-MENT] — *I'm in my element.*
